questions.prompt: Which of these mountains are in the Himalayas?
questions.fact: Kangchenjunga, on the border of Nepal and India, is the third highest mountain in the world.

questions.prompt: Which of these animals are primates?
questions.fact: A tarsier's eyes are each as big as its brain, and they cannot move in their sockets.

questions.prompt: How many seconds did the Wright brothers' first powered flight last?
questions.fact: Twelve seconds, covering 37 m. That is shorter than the wingspan of a jumbo jet.

questions.prompt: How many players does an ice hockey team have on the ice?
questions.fact: Six, including the goalie, and players swap on and off every minute or so.

questions.prompt: What colour is an aircraft's black box flight recorder?
questions.hint: It has to be easy to spot in wreckage.
questions.fact: Nobody is quite sure why it is called a black box. It has always been painted bright orange.

questions.prompt: Which sauce is made from egg yolks, butter and lemon?
questions.hint: It is the sauce on eggs Benedict.
questions.fact: Béchamel is a white sauce of milk, butter and flour. Add cheese and it becomes Mornay.
